title: Psionics detect NHI at Sedona base

tellings.quote: there are allegations that that base is NHI. I've had people who are psionic tell me that they have detected NHI in that in that area.

plain: A base near Sedona, Arizona, is alleged to be linked to NHI, short for non-human intelligence, and people who call themselves psionic, meaning they claim to sense things with the mind, say they have felt such beings in the area. Ross Coulthart, a guest who says he has located a UFO base in Arizona, tells Michels about these allegations and says the psionic people told him this themselves. If true, it would mean non-human beings are active at a known site in the American Southwest.
